title: ISP Tracking & DNS Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your ISP tracking risk level and get personalized recommendations to protect your DNS queries and browsing privacy from monitoring.
description: Evaluate how exposed you are to ISP tracking and DNS monitoring. This calculator analyzes your current privacy setup and provides a personalized risk score with actionable steps to protect your browsing data from your internet provider.

formula: let baseRisk = 70; if(inputs.dnsProvider === 'isp-default') baseRisk += 20; if(inputs.dnsEncryption === 'none') baseRisk += 15; else if(inputs.dnsEncryption === 'doh' || inputs.dnsEncryption === 'dot') baseRisk -= 25; if(inputs.vpnUsage === 'always') baseRisk -= 30; else if(inputs.vpnUsage === 'often') baseRisk -= 20; else if(inputs.vpnUsage === 'sometimes') baseRisk -= 10; if(inputs.browserPrivacy === 'strict') baseRisk -= 15; else if(inputs.browserPrivacy === 'enhanced') baseRisk -= 10; else if(inputs.browserPrivacy === 'basic') baseRisk -= 5; if(inputs.streamingHabits === 'torrenting') baseRisk += 15; else if(inputs.streamingHabits === 'heavy') baseRisk += 10; if(inputs.dataUsage > 1000) baseRisk += 10; if(inputs.optOutAttempts === 'opted-out') baseRisk -= 10; else if(inputs.optOutAttempts === 'no-option') baseRisk += 5; let riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk)); let privacyGrade = riskScore <= 20 ? 'A': riskScore <= 40 ? 'B': riskScore <= 60 ? 'C': riskScore <= 80 ? 'D': 'F'; let exposureLevel = riskScore <= 25 ? 'Minimal - Well Protected': riskScore <= 50 ? 'Moderate - Some Visibility': riskScore <= 75 ? 'High - Significant Tracking': 'Critical - Maximum Exposure'; return { riskScore, privacyGrade, exposureLevel };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your ISP tracking risk based on DNS configuration, VPN usage, browser privacy settings, and data usage patterns. It considers how ISPs monitor unencrypted DNS queries, analyze traffic patterns, and collect browsing metadata even when using HTTPS.
tips: Switch to encrypted DNS (DNS over HTTPS) in your browser settings to hide DNS queries from your ISP
Use a privacy-focused browser or a reputable VPN service to encrypt all traffic and hide your browsing from ISP monitoring
Change your DNS provider from ISP default to privacy-focused options like Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) or Quad9
Check your ISP's privacy policy and opt-out of data sharing programs if available
Consider using Tor browser or other privacy-focused browsers for sensitive browsing activities

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy protection. Your ISP has minimal visibility into your browsing habits.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy setup with room for improvement. Some browsing data may be visible to your ISP.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant ISP tracking exposure. Your browsing habits and DNS queries are likely being monitored.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum ISP tracking exposure. Your ISP can see most of your browsing activity and DNS queries.
